name: prismoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @prismoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @prismoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @prismoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @prismoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @prismoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @prismoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @prismoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @prismoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @prismoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @prismoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @prismoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @prismoffice/docs && npm run test -w @prismoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @prismoffice/shell && npm run test -w @prismoffice/slides && npm run test -w @prismoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @prismoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @prismoffice/editor-contract && npm run test -w @prismoffice/sdk-shared && npm run test -w @prismoffice/editor-service && npm run test -w @prismoffice/reference-host
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/editor-contract && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/sdk-shared && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/editor-service && npm run typecheck -w @prismoffice/reference-host
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @prismoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @prismoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @prismoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @prismoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @prismoffice/markdown" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 npm run dev -w @prismoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @prismoffice/docs && npm run build -w @prismoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @prismoffice/slides && npm run build -w @prismoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @prismoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @prismoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @prismoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @prismoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @prismoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @prismoffice/shell
